pull_request.title: Dynamic node-local ephemeral volumes: alpha implementation
pull_request.body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind feature
/kind api-change

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Implements Alpha support for **KEP-6395: Dynamic Node-Local Ephemeral Volumes** behind the `DynamicNodeLocalEphemeralVolumes` feature gate.

This PR has the following dependencies:
- [x] https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/143474
- [x] https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/141807
- [x] https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/143715

#### Which issue(s) this PR is related to:

KEP: https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/issues/6395

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

Note that we decided to remove the mutable mounts portion of this PR, deferring that to the next cycle.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
Added alpha support for dynamically adding and removing node-local ephemeral volumes.
* The following volume types are supported: `emptyDir`, `configMap`, `secret`, `projected`, `image`.
* You may add and remove these volume types under the `/dynamic`subresource behind the `DynamicNodeLocalEphemeralVolumes` feature gate.
* To use newly added volumes, you must use the `DynamicContainers` feature to add a container referencing the new volume. In this first alpha, dynamically adjusting `volumeMounts` of a preexisting container is not yet allowed.
```

#### AI usage disclosure:

YES — An AI coding assistant was used to help draft implementation code, unit/integration/node E2E tests, and structure the commit series. All changes were reviewed and verified by the author.
